name: Streetwise
feature_notes: Reusable service address suggestions for contractor vessels with independent coverage settings. Richmond-area coverage is enabled for Legacy Plumbing and Signal Restoration. Other contractor vessels may opt in. Staff can open a matched job location in Maps.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.
